matrix_brightness.semantics: Generate and preserve canonical scene first; gamma-correct canonical RGB, then apply Matrix-only final output luminance scaling. Zero is black, 255 is identity/full output, and any nonzero canonical pixel remains participating at nonzero brightness. Kernel, audio, motion, geometry, animation-clock, scene evolution, and AUX/DDP inputs are unchanged.
matrix_brightness.host_contract: PASS at brightness 0, 1, 8, 20, 64, 128, and 255; canonical 512-pixel fixture unchanged; patched-source application against the exact bound source passed.
